drift_analysis.finding: Every TEST row drifts 0.35-0.51, FAR above the 0.07 expectation. Reported as-is, zero re-runs. Cause: board-18 is a single fabrication board (16 same-fab devices); DEV reference draws 16 devices from 4 different boards. Global K=16 clustering of same-fab siblings collapses (HDBSCAN finds only K_est=4-10, merges devices), while oracle-K@16 recovers only 0.35-0.44 vs DEV 0.70-0.80. kNN-1 stays HIGH on TEST (0.89-0.99) with healthy gap (0.43-0.58) -> the fingerprint info IS present locally; it is GLOBAL partition at K16 that fails (the density-vs-separability split).
drift_analysis.vs_board20_fineness: Does NOT cleanly contradict step5 same-board board-20 K8=0.895: single-board separability is strongly K- and board-dependent — easy at K8/board-20 (0.90), hard at K16/board-18 (0.36). Doubling same-fab device count and a different board both plausibly contribute.
drift_analysis.provisional_headline: A1 (P1 CosFace, the provisional locked op-point) TEST HDBSCAN ARI=0.219 vs DEV 0.727. First and only TEST touch of this op-point.
